title: Slingshot
body:
"Fire a bunch of marbles at your worst enemies!"

Description

The Slingshot is a special item bought in the Classic Store for $727. It is part of the random rotation in the store.

This is a slingshot shooting balls with the texture of a classic brick. The balls make the sound of a rubber band bouncing off.

Trivia

  • The slingshot can shoot without reloading.
